name: Tim Spriggs
bio: Tim Spriggs is an Australian musician, producer and actor.

credits.title: A Corpse in Kensington
credits.overview: A mysterious killing spree ignites suspicion among three former classmates who have rekindled a love triangle in their hometown on Halloween night.

credits.title: A Toy Maker
credits.overview: A Toy Maker fights off an evil real estate mogul by turning his goons into human marionettes.

credits.title: Skate to Hell
credits.overview: A group of teenagers steal a supernatural skateboard owned by Satan's son. Now the devil wants it back.

credits.overview: On Halloween night, 1997, a masked killer brings slasher films to life in Carpenter Falls. A video store clerk and her friends must survive his deadly game before they’re picked off one by one.

credits.overview: In 1940s, the nuns of a remote Scottish island convent ready for an impending storm, but when a baby is left on their doorstep, Sister Agnes becomes convinced he is the Devil and wants to kill the child. credits.title: Backwoods Blood Feud
credits.overview: A group of criminals on the run in a cold, winter forest find themselves caught in the middle of an ancient feud between the monsters that rule the day and the creatures that rule the night.

credits.title: Desert Fiends
credits.overview: Follows six friends who break down in the middle of nowhere, on the way to a concert, and encounter the desert fiends -- a deranged family who lives in the desert, killing anyone they come across.

credits.title: Residence
credits.overview: The enigmatic hero, a speechless child and a ragtag motley crew journey through a zombie filled apocalyptic landscape to seek shelter in a medieval fun park whilst being pursued by a deranged lunatic.

credits.title: Isleen Pines
credits.overview: A group of friends get together for the annual Halloween party, but are interrupted by mysterious visitors.

credits.title: The Haunting at Saint Joseph's
credits.overview: An engaged Muslim doctor, her fiancé, and their friends go on a holiday at St. Joseph’s Guesthouse, unaware that it was the site of a sacrifice of an innocent centuries before. They soon come to believe that it's haunted and causing them to go crazy, as their emotions spiral out of control.

credits.title: Thicker Than Water
credits.overview: A sister struggles to keep her brothers together when the eldest, a recovering drug addict, returns from rehab.
